name: Ars MidJourney Watercolor
description: MJ7 VERSION Update: The dataset was rebuilt entirely from scratch using MidJourney V7. The main difference from v1 and v2 is a shift towards more natural colors and textures. The Lora is trained on MidJourney Images that use my "Personalised Style" + Watercolor What is new in v2: Significantly increased the training dataset Added support for a wider range of concepts Removed most of the biases that were present in v1 (closed eyes everywhere for example) Added 3 different intensity of the colors ( intense , deep , soft colors ) My personal style is changed a little bit , so the images are more "crisp and clear" Works without the trigger words ArsMJStyle, Watercolor Works great in the 0.2 - 1.5 range. Start ~1. As Watercolor is strong existing style and looks really nice as an abstract painting, you can go pretty high with the strength and still get a nice result. I hope you will enjoy this LoRA as much as I did creating it!
